lines.en: I hang under the leaf, swaying slightly
The wind turns me half a circle
I hang down from the leaf stem
My shell rocks with the wind
I hang there without moving
The sun makes my shell shine
I am in the leaf's shadow
I have no feet to walk with
This single thread holds me
The wind swings me like a little bell
I sway on this branch
I pull the thread a little tighter
The leaf stem is thin enough to bend

lines.zh: 我从叶背这边转到那边
lines.en: I turn from one side of the leaf to the other

lines.zh: 我的壳在光里透着暗色
lines.en: My shell shows a dark tone in the light
I sway along with the branch
Things are changing inside my shell

lines.zh: 我挂在草叶下，像是睡着了
lines.en: I hang beneath a grass blade as if asleep.
I wait for myself to take shape
A thin sheen lies on my surface

lines.zh: 壳里我的翅芽一点点张开
lines.en: Inside the shell my wing buds slowly spread.
I hear the wind outside
This shell of mine is thin
I press against my own inner wall
I wait quietly
The colors of the world outside have changed

lines.zh: 我的壳上凝了一层水汽
lines.en: A film of moisture beads on my shell

lines.zh: 我一节一节地安静下来
lines.en: I go quiet, segment by segment
You keep staring at me
There is nothing I can do right now

lines.zh: 我的壳不透明，你看不见里面
lines.en: My shell is opaque, you cannot see inside
Do not touch this thread

lines.zh: 你等我化开这层壳再说
lines.en: Wait until I've broken out of this shell.

lines.zh: 你看，我连眼睛都还没长好
lines.en: Look, I do not even have proper eyes yet
What are you waiting there for
I hang here, quite secure
I am the only one on this leaf
Do not shake this branch
My shell was pressed
It hurts badly inside
The thread still holds

lines.zh: 一震之后，我的丝线还在颤
lines.en: After the jolt my silk keeps trembling.
A crack opened in my shell

lines.zh: 我听见里面有东西碎了
lines.en: I heard something break inside me
I try to press myself against the leaf

lines.zh: 这一下让我的时间乱了
lines.en: That disrupted my timing
I shed a thin layer
I am still slowly mending
I cannot eat that
I do not need to eat now
Handing it to me is no use
My mouth is still forming
I cannot even move
At this stage I only wait
Leave it on the leaf
It might be useful when I come out
I am watching from inside this shell
I have no use for it now
You touched my leaf

lines.zh: 叶子一晃，我在丝上转了半圈
lines.en: The leaf jolts and I spin half a turn on my silk.
The thread holds, it is fine

lines.zh: 被撞后我在半空打了个转
lines.en: After the bump I spin once in the air.

lines.zh: 这一下差点把丝线扯断
lines.en: That nearly snapped the thread
I hang there afraid to move

lines.zh: 你的手指碰到了我的壳
lines.en: Your finger touched my shell
Something inside me jolted
Even the leaf stem has bent
We are separated by a shell
I am still at this stage
There is no such thing inside this shell
My shape is not even settled
You are asking about later
Right now I have only waiting
Something inside me shifted
At this stage I cannot speak
My time is counted in days
I go on hanging under the leaf

lines.zh: 这些都是出去之后的事
lines.en: All that comes after I emerge
I cannot pick anything up
I do not even have hands
This thread is all I have
I look at it from inside the shell

lines.zh: 它离我很近，但我够不到
lines.en: It is close, but I cannot reach
Let the wind blow it away
All I can do now is hang
The leaf will catch it for me
I did nothing at all
At this stage I have no desires
Something is moving outside
I can only feel the vibration
I cannot hold onto anything
My position cannot change
The wind turns me that way
I hear the sound of wings

lines.zh: 那可能是我将来的样子
lines.en: That might be what I will be
I can only wait and watch

lines.zh: 有影子扫过，我连转都转不动
lines.en: A shadow sweeps past and I can't even turn.
I have turned back again
I hang facing that way
My shell blocks my view
I keep listening outside
The wind carried it away
I cannot judge anything
I can only sense where the light comes from
It is getting warmer outside
I think I am nearly ready
Just a little longer
I gradually go still

lines.zh: 我吊在丝线上，只能挨这一下
lines.en: I hang on my silk and can only take the blow.
I cannot do that
I can only put my shell in front
My shell has hardened a little
One knock and I swayed for a long time

lines.zh: 我的壳挂在这儿，挡不了谁
lines.en: My shell just hangs here; it stops no one.
This shell took it for me
I am still where I was
I wait for it to leave on its own
I keep hanging like this
I have finished sealing myself under the leaf

lines.zh: 我从毛虫变成了这一团
lines.en: I went from caterpillar to this bundle
The silk is my own
I hang under the leaf, quite secure

lines.zh: 我的外壳一节一节硬了
lines.en: My shell hardened segment by segment

lines.zh: 我不知道自己会变成什么样
lines.en: I do not know what I will become

lines.zh: 我在草叶背面挂稳了这团丝
lines.en: I've hung my silk bundle steady on the back of a grass leaf.
I wait for time here
I wrapped myself up tightly

lines.zh: 我选了草叶的背面，把丝吐满
lines.en: I pick a grass leaf's underside and coat it with silk.

lines.zh: 火离我很近，我的壳在发烫
lines.en: Fire is close, my shell is heating

lines.zh: 我从叶子下面掉了下去
lines.en: I dropped from beneath the leaf
A drop of water enclosed me entirely

lines.zh: 气浪把叶子和我一起撕开
lines.en: The blast tore the leaf and me apart
Something grazed my shell
That magic soaked through the shell
I do not eat at this stage
The lightning made the whole leaf shake
The leaf and the branch are gone
